verdict.rationale: Amplitude AI lets users ask plain-language questions and get answers/insights across their data ('Amplitude AI surfaces answers across all your data', 'expert-level answers in seconds'), and an embeddable agent grounded in behavioral data can proactively guide/answer for users. This is first-party documented but lacks independent hands-on verification of insight quality. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of the AI insights feature's accuracy and depth, more detail on proactive suggestion generation beyond Q&A.
